title: File:Via Roma dans le centre de Courmayeur au matin (juin 2024).JPG
claims: The file shows Via Roma in central Courmayeur in morning light, with stone paving, alpine buildings, a white canopy structure, flower beds, people and snow-covered peaks behind the town.
The file metadata identifies the location as Courmayeur in the Aosta Valley, Italy; it contains no race, CCC or UTMB event context and is a location photograph, not a race-day photograph.
